title: Bottle glass, sea-worn
summary: Green, frosted, edges entirely gone. Approximately forty years in the water, at a guess nobody has checked.

body.text: The coast here retreats by about a metre a year, and has been doing so for long enough that a town, eight churches and a harbour are now some distance offshore and below. Against that, a fragment of a bottle is not much of a loss.
It is nonetheless the correct green. Held up, it is the colour of the sea about two hundred metres out on a day with no cloud, which is a colour the sea is not often willing to be.
